data.name: Naurus
data.gender_notes: Naurus is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawr', meaning 'to be light'. This name symbolizes the inner light and delight that one finds in the presence of Allah. The name Naurus carries the meaning “Light, Delight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naurus usually hope their child will grow to embody light, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reflects the spiritual journey towards finding inner light and delight in the divine presence.
data.etymology: Naurus belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naurus total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ناروس
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name Naurus is derived from the Arabic word 'نار' (nār) which means 'sun' and the suffix '-وس' (-ūs) which means 'light' or 'source'. Thus, Naurus can be interpreted as 'the light of the sun' or 'the source of light from the sun'.

in_urdu.name: ناروس
in_urdu.long_meaning: The name Naurus in Urdu is translated as 'remaining as light of the sun' or 'the sun's continuing light'. This meaning is derived from the Arabic origin of the name.

in_hindi.name: नारूस
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Naurus is translated as 'the light of the sun'. This meaning is derived from the Arabic origin of the name.

in_pashto.name: ناروس
in_pashto.long_meaning: The name Naurus in Pashto is translated as 'sun's light' or 'the light from the sun'. This meaning is derived from the Arabic origin of the name.
